title: Law to require faster snow clearing at bus stops
summary: This bill would require the Department of Sanitation to clear snow and ice from bus stops, bus shelters and connecting sidewalk paths within 7 hours after receiving at least 5 complaints of a property owner's failure to do so. It would also require the department to launch a public online map by January 31, 2027 tracking the status of snow and ice removal at bus stops and shelters citywide.
